description_en: Queries the list of quota increase applications
description_zh: 查询配额提升申请列表
name: ListQuotaApplications

parameters.help_en: The token that marks the position from which you want to start the query. Leave this parameter empty to query from the beginning
parameters.help_zh: 用来标记开始查询数据的位置。置空表示从头开始
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of records to return in this query.

Valid values: 1 to 200. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
本次查询的最大记录条数。

取值范围：1~200。默认值：30
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The abbreviation of the cloud service name
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en:
The approval status of the quota increase application. Valid values:

Disagree: Rejected.

Agree: Approved.

Process: Under review.

Cancel: Closed
parameters.help_zh:
配额提升申请的审批状态。取值：

Disagree：拒绝。

Agree：审核通过。

Process：审核中。

Cancel：已关闭
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The keyword for searching quota increase applications
parameters.help_zh: 配额提升申请的搜索关键字
parameters.name: key_word

fields.help_en:
The key of the quota dimension.

`Dimensions.N.Key` and `Dimensions.N.Value` must be specified together. The valid values of N depend on the number of dimensions supported by the cloud service. You can call [ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~) to query the quota dimensions supported by a cloud service. The length of the returned array is the value of N
fields.help_zh:
配额维度的Key。

`Dimensions.N.Key`和`Dimensions.N.Value`必须同时设置。N的取值范围取决于对应云产品支持的维度个数，您可以从[ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~)查询云产品支持的配额维度，返回数组长度就是N
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the quota dimension.

`Dimensions.N.Key` and `Dimensions.N.Value` must be specified together. The valid values of N depend on the number of dimensions supported by the cloud service. You can call [ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~) to query the quota dimensions supported by a cloud service. The length of the returned array is the value of N
fields.help_zh:
配额维度的Value。

`Dimensions.N.Key`和`Dimensions.N.Value`必须同时设置。N的取值范围取决于对应云产品支持的维度个数，您可以从[ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~)查询云产品支持的配额维度，返回数组长度就是N
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The quota dimensions.
The dimensions are properties of a quota item. A combination of dimensions (Dimensions) and a quota ID (QuotaActionCode) uniquely identifies a quota item.
Some cloud services require dimensions. You can call [ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~) to query the quota dimensions supported by a cloud service. The `Requisite` response parameter indicates whether a dimension is required
parameters.help_zh:
配额维度。
配额项的属性，维度（Dimensions）+配额ID（QuotaActionCode）确定唯一的配额项。
部分云产品维度必填。您可以从[ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~)查询云产品支持的配额维度，返回参数`Requisite`表示该维度是否必填
parameters.name: dimensions

parameters.help_en:
The quota category. Valid values:
CommonQuota: general quota.
FlowControl: API rate limit.
WhiteListLabel: privilege
parameters.help_zh:
配额种类。取值：
CommonQuota：通用配额。
FlowControl：API速率配额。
WhiteListLabel：权益配额
parameters.name: quota_category
